plaid.blurb: openbooks pulls new transactions automatically through Plaid, an open-banking aggregator. You connect once with your Plaid API keys; there are no files to manage.
plaid.docsLabel: Get keys in the Plaid dashboard

gocardless.blurb: openbooks pulls transactions through GoCardless Bank Account Data (formerly Nordigen) — a free European open-banking feed. Create a Secret ID and Secret Key in their dashboard.

truelayer.blurb: openbooks pulls transactions through TrueLayer, a UK/EU open-banking provider. Paste an access token from your TrueLayer console.

sftp.blurb: Your bank pushes statement files (OFX/CSV/CAMT/BAI2/MT940) to openbooks over SFTP. We create a dedicated login for this bank; you hand the host, username, and password to your bank, and files that land are imported automatically.

manual.blurb: No automation — you'll upload statement files by hand from the account's page in Banking whenever you have them. Good for accounts your bank can't feed.

pspSettlements.title: PSP settlements
pspSettlements.description: Import payment-provider payout settlements. Fees, disputes, and foreign exchange adjustments post through the general ledger.
pspSettlements.reasonTooShort: Enter a reversal reason of at least 5 characters.
pspSettlements.bankAccountHint: The bank account the provider payout lands in. Required before posting.
pspSettlements.feeAccountHint: The expense account for provider processing fees. Required before posting.
pspSettlements.clearingAccountHint: The clearing account holding provider receivables until payout. Required before posting.
pspSettlements.payloadShapeHint: Each row needs id, type, amount in minor units, fee, net and currency — e.g. '{"id":"ch_1","type":"charge","amount":250000,"fee":7250,"net":242750,"currency":"USD"}'. Without a type the row cannot be classified.
pspSettlements.genericPayloadHint: One JSON object for a single settlement: id, currency, charge/refund/fee/net amounts, and optional lines.
pspSettlements.invalidStripePayload: Stripe payload must be a JSON array of balance transactions (id, type, amount, fee, net, currency).
pspSettlements.invalidGenericPayload: This provider payload must be a single JSON object, not an array.
pspSettlements.reversalPlaceholder: Required evidence for a controlled correction
pspSettlements.shopifyPayloadHint: One JSON object with payout and transactions: '{"payout": {"id", "currency", "issuedAt"}, "transactions": [{"id", "type", "amount", "fee", "net", "currency", "sourceOrderId"}]}'. Amounts are decimal strings; type is charge, refund, dispute, reserve, adjustment or payout.
pspSettlements.paypalPayloadLabel: Transaction Search export (JSON) or settlement report (CSV)
pspSettlements.paypalPayloadHint: Paste '{"transactions": [{"transaction_info": {...}}]}' from the Transaction Search API, or paste the settlement report CSV with its header row. Name the export in External ref so the batch stays idempotent.
pspSettlements.invalidShopifyPayload: Shopify payload must be one JSON object with payout and transactions.
pspSettlements.squarePayloadHint: One JSON object with payout and entries: '{"payout": {"id", "amount_money"}, "entries": [{"id", "type", "gross_amount_money", "fee_amount_money", "net_amount_money"}]}'. Amounts are integer minor units. Enter the Square payout id as the external ref.
pspSettlements.invalidSquarePayload: Square payload must be one JSON object with payout and entries.
pspSettlements.fxRateHint: The provider's own rate, e.g. the Stripe balance transaction exchange_rate.
pspSettlements.fxIncomplete: Enter the charge currency, rate and rate source together, or leave all three blank.
pspSettlements.detailEmptyLines: This batch has no evidence lines.
pspSettlements.batchJournalHint: One journal evidences every unmatched charge line. The suggestion proposes — confirming applies it to the whole batch.
pspSettlements.batchJournalNoCandidates: No posted journal totals exactly the batch charges.
pspSettlements.pullSummary: The scheduler pulls each enabled provider on its payout scan.
